title: Power Lay-Up off Two Feet
description: Players finish with a two-foot jump stop and a strong two-hand lift, the safest finish in traffic for developing players.

content.objective: Finish strongly off two feet with the body shielding the ball and the ball high.
content.setup: Lines at both wings with a ball each.
content.organization: Alternate wings; rebound and switch lines.
instructions: Jump-stop on two feet with the shoulders parallel to the baseline.
Keep the ball high at the chin with two hands.
Jump strongly off both feet and finish off the board with the outside hand.
coachingPoints: Stop on two feet, wide base.
commonMistakes: Bringing the ball down to the waist.
Jump stop too far from the rim.
content.safety: Finishers land on two feet and clear the lane; the next player waits until the landing area is empty.
progressions: Add a shot fake before the power finish.
regressions: Start from a stationary jump stop.
No dribble: catch and power up.
variations: Power finish after an offensive rebound.
successCriteria: Lands balanced on two feet every rep.
content.gameApplication: In traffic, a two-foot finish is stronger and keeps the player on balance.
